offering_description.value: Operates an online automotive marketplace where consumers search new and used car listings and compare prices. It sells listing and advertising placements to car dealers, delivered through websites and mobile apps.

primary_products.value: online vehicle marketplace; dealer listing placements; dealer advertising tools; vehicle valuation tools

primary_services.value: digital marketing for dealers; vehicle sale lead services; dealer software services

customer_segment.value: B2B: franchised and independent car dealerships; B2C: individual car shoppers and vehicle sellers

end_markets.value: automotive retail; used car sales; digital advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring dealer subscriptions for listing and marketplace access; advertising: dealers pay for ad placements and promoted vehicle listings

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: takes in vehicle inventory data from dealers and sells marketplace access to dealers and shoppers; service provider: provides marketing and lead services to car dealers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and United Kingdom

specialization.value: niche specialist: single online automotive marketplace and related dealer marketing products

distribution_channels.value: online: websites and mobile apps where shoppers browse and sellers list cars; direct sales: sales teams selling dealer subscriptions and advertising

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer data privacy and advertising rules that apply to online marketplaces and automotive sales
